inception/mercury-2.5-preview.name: Mercury 2.5 Preview
inception/mercury-2.5-preview.description: Mercury 2.5 Preview is Inception's latest and most intelligent diffusion language model. It delivers a 10+ point intelligence gain over Mercury 2, with tunable reasoning, parallel tool calls, schema-aligned JSON output, and a 260K context window. It is built for latency-sensitive production work such as search agents, voice pipelines, customer support, rapid coding iteration, and coding subagents.

meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.description: A much cheaper opt-in version of Muse Spark 1.2 with the same multimodal coding and agentic capabilities. Prompts and outputs sent to this Contributor model may be used by Meta for training and to improve its products; use the standard Muse Spark 1.2 model if you do not want your data used for training.

meta/muse-spark-1.3.name: Muse Spark 1.3
meta/muse-spark-1.3.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta for long-running agentic, multi-agent, and coding workflows. It improves long-horizon agent collaboration, instruction following, and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.

meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor
meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.description: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is a frontier multimodal reasoning model for long-horizon coding and agentic workflows, with strong gains in computer use, browsing, professional tool use, codebase understanding, and million-token retrieval. It accepts text, images, audio, video, and files, supports tool calling and structured output, and always reasons before answering. Prompts and outputs may be used by Meta for training and to improve its products.

meta/muse-spark-open.name: Muse Spark Open
meta/muse-spark-open.description: Muse Spark Open is an 816B total / 42B active open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Meta for coding and long-horizon agentic work, with 1M-token context.
